issues.title: SteamOS / ROG Ally X – Going Commando NTSC build update
issues.author: kwfrrb562c-boop
issues.body:
Just wanted to provide an update on my attempts to get Ratchet & Clank: Going Commando building through OpenRAC on SteamOS (ROG Ally X, Z2 Extreme).
I've finally managed to get the build process underway, currently sitting at 9% compilation!
Getting this far was a little more involved than anticipated. SteamOS didn't have Ninja, Clang or CMake available to the launcher, so I had to work around the missing dependencies:
